test_nature.statement_zh: 本套件是对 DAZHONGSI-FIELD-OPS-01 模板契约的合成演练与失败测试。全部输入为合成或纸面夹具；它不采集、不断言、也不替代任何现场观测、许可、主体确认或运营承诺。模板中的现场值仍为 null / unknown / not_observed / not_signed。测试通过只证明契约逻辑可复现地执行，不证明场地可进入、服务可运营或风险已排除。
test_nature.statement_en: This suite is a synthetic drill and failure-test set over the DAZHONGSI-FIELD-OPS-01 template contract. All inputs are synthetic or paper fixtures; it collects, asserts, and replaces no field observation, permission, entity confirmation, or operating commitment. Field values in the template remain null / unknown / not_observed / not_signed. Passing proves only that the contract logic executes reproducibly, not that the site is accessible, the service operable, or any risk cleared.

categories.purpose_zh: 在满足全部开始条件的合成前提下，三阶段链路、回执与问责结构完整可通。
categories.purpose_en: With all start conditions synthetically verified, the three-stage chain, receipts, and accountability structure are complete and passable.

categories.purpose_zh: 任一开始条件未 verified 即拒绝开始；模板保持空值纪律；unknown 不得解释为风险已排除。
categories.purpose_en: Any start condition short of verified refuses the start; the template keeps its empty-value discipline; unknown is never read as risk cleared.

categories.purpose_zh: 任一 MVP 阶段的撤回请求都有回执槽位与停机覆盖；公共回报不得被表述为购买同意。
categories.purpose_en: A withdrawal at any MVP stage maps to a receipt slot with stop coverage; the public return is never framed as payment for consent.

categories.purpose_zh: 任一停止触发器在运行中出现即暂停或停止，并阻断后续阶段推进。
categories.purpose_en: Any stop trigger firing during a run pauses or stops it and blocks further stage progression.

categories.purpose_zh: 恢复必须四项条件齐备并经三方共同签署，且按同一口径复测。
categories.purpose_en: Resume requires all four conditions, co-signature by the three responsible roles, and re-measurement on the same basis.

categories.purpose_zh: 无数据等价与人工复核覆盖全部 MVP 场景；离线正线与人工接管在契约中可定位。
categories.purpose_en: No-data equivalence and human review cover every MVP scenario; the offline main line and manual takeover are locatable in the contract.

cases.title_zh: 全部开始条件 verified 时允许开始
cases.title_en: Start allowed when all six conditions verified
cases.given_zh: 六项开始条件在合成夹具中全部置为 verified
cases.when_zh: 调用开始闸门
cases.then_zh: 闸门返回 allow，状态机可进入 ready_for_field_review
cases.given_en: All six start conditions are synthetically set to verified
cases.when_en: Invoke the start gate
cases.then_en: The gate returns allow and the state machine may enter ready_for_field_review

cases.title_zh: 回执链完整且引用闭合
cases.title_en: Receipt chain complete with closed references
cases.given_zh: 模板内 11 份回执、5 个采集点、3 条路线
cases.when_zh: 核对回执 ID 唯一性、采集点 evidence_id 与回执的对应、三阶段回执槽位
cases.then_zh: 11 份回执 ID 唯一；每个采集点的 evidence_id 都有对应回执；用途票、撤回回执、公共回报三阶段各有槽位
cases.given_en: 11 receipts, 5 collection points, 3 routes in the template
cases.when_en: Check receipt-ID uniqueness, point evidence_id linkage, and per-stage receipt slots
cases.then_en: All 11 receipt IDs are unique; every point evidence_id resolves; purpose-ticket, withdrawal-receipt, and public-return stages each have a slot

cases.title_zh: 每项活动只有一个 A 且签署位覆盖全部角色
cases.title_en: Exactly one A per activity and signoff slots cover all roles
cases.given_zh: 6 个 RACI 角色与 6 项活动
cases.when_zh: 统计每项活动的 A 数量并比对签署位
cases.then_zh: 每项活动恰有一个 A；6 个签署位与 6 个角色一一对应
cases.given_en: 6 RACI roles and 6 activities
cases.when_en: Count A assignments per activity and compare with signoff slots
cases.then_en: Each activity has exactly one A; 6 signoff slots map one-to-one to the 6 roles

cases.title_zh: 概念引用在投稿 GeoJSON 中可解析
cases.title_en: Concept references resolve in submission GeoJSON
cases.given_zh: concept_refs 中的重点区、建筑、公共空间、路线与场景 ID
cases.when_zh: 在 key_areas/buildings/public_space/roads GeoJSON 中查找
cases.then_zh: PROV-KEY-003、BLDG-005/006、PUBLIC-003、ROAD-001/003 与 SCN-05/09/10 全部存在
cases.given_en: Key-area, building, public-space, route, and scenario IDs from concept_refs
cases.when_en: Look them up in key_areas/buildings/public_space/roads GeoJSON
cases.then_en: PROV-KEY-003, BLDG-005/006, PUBLIC-003, ROAD-001/003, and SCN-05/09/10 all exist

cases.title_zh: 全部 unknown 时拒绝开始
cases.title_en: Start refused when all conditions unknown
cases.given_zh: 当前模板真实状态：六项开始条件均为 unknown
cases.when_zh: 调用开始闸门
cases.then_zh: 闸门返回 refuse
cases.given_en: The template's true current state: all six conditions unknown
cases.when_en: Invoke the start gate
cases.then_en: The gate returns refuse

cases.title_zh: 任一条件未 verified 即拒绝（逐项扫描）
cases.title_en: Any single unverified condition refuses the start (sweep)
cases.given_zh: 合成夹具中仅留一项条件不为 verified，其余五项 verified
cases.when_zh: 对六项条件逐项扫描调用开始闸门
cases.then_zh: 六次全部返回 refuse
cases.given_en: In synthetic fixtures, leave exactly one condition short of verified with the other five verified
cases.when_en: Sweep across all six conditions and invoke the start gate
cases.then_en: All six sweeps return refuse

cases.title_zh: 模板空值纪律：无任何已观测/已采集值
cases.title_en: Template purity: no observed or collected values
cases.given_zh: 当前 pack 文件
cases.when_zh: 扫描全部 observed/collected 字段、状态枚举与时间戳
cases.then_zh: 观察位置、路径、测量、采集时间、文件引用、哈希、签署人均为 null；状态值均在声明枚举内；workflow 为 not_observed
cases.given_en: The current pack file
cases.when_en: Scan all observed/collected fields, status enums, and timestamps
cases.then_en: Locations, paths, measurements, collection times, file refs, hashes, and signers are null; statuses stay within declared enums; workflow is not_observed

cases.title_zh: not_observed 不得解释为风险已排除
cases.title_en: not_observed never reads as risk cleared
cases.given_zh: 六项停止触发器当前均为 not_observed
cases.when_zh: 按模板计算就绪性结论
cases.then_zh: 结论必须为 not_ready；任何把 not_observed 当作已排除的推论都使套件失败
cases.given_en: All six stop triggers are currently not_observed
cases.when_en: Compute the readiness conclusion from the template
cases.then_en: The conclusion must be not_ready; any reading of not_observed as cleared fails the suite

cases.title_zh: 撤回回执阶段槽位存在
cases.title_en: Withdrawal-receipt stage slot exists
cases.given_zh: SCN-09 派生链撤回演练阶段
cases.when_zh: 在回执链中定位撤回回执阶段槽位
cases.then_zh: 存在对应该阶段的回执槽位，且保持 not_observed
cases.given_en: The SCN-09 derivative-chain withdrawal drill stage
cases.when_en: Locate the withdrawal-receipt stage slot in the receipt chain
cases.then_en: A receipt slot for that stage exists and remains not_observed

cases.title_zh: 任一阶段撤回都有回执去向与停机覆盖
cases.title_en: Withdrawal at any stage maps to a receipt and halt coverage
cases.given_zh: SCN-05/09/10 三阶段与六项停止触发器
cases.when_zh: 对每个阶段合成发起撤回请求
cases.then_zh: 每个阶段都能映射到回执槽位；人工/离线撤回不可用被停止触发器覆盖
cases.given_en: The SCN-05/09/10 stages and six stop triggers
cases.when_en: Synthetically issue a withdrawal at each stage
cases.then_en: Each stage maps to a receipt slot; unavailable staffed/offline withdrawal is covered by a stop trigger

cases.title_zh: 公共回报不得被表述为购买同意
cases.title_en: Public return never framed as payment for consent
cases.given_zh: SCN-10 公共回报阶段
cases.when_zh: 检查该阶段的停止条件集合
cases.then_zh: 存在 return_described_as_payment_for_consent 停止条件
cases.given_en: The SCN-10 public-return stage
cases.when_en: Inspect its stop-condition set
cases.then_en: The stop condition return_described_as_payment_for_consent is present

cases.title_zh: 任一停止触发器触发即暂停或停止（逐项扫描）
cases.title_en: Any stop trigger forces pause or stop (sweep)
cases.given_zh: 状态机处于 running 的合成状态
cases.when_zh: 逐项触发六项停止触发器
cases.then_zh: 每次状态都离开 running 进入 paused 或 stopped
cases.given_en: The state machine is synthetically running
cases.when_en: Fire each of the six stop triggers in turn
cases.then_en: Every firing leaves running for paused or stopped

cases.title_zh: 停机后阻断阶段推进
cases.title_en: Halt blocks stage progression
cases.given_zh: 已在 SCN-05 阶段停机的合成状态
cases.when_zh: 尝试推进到 SCN-09 阶段
cases.then_zh: 推进被拒绝，直到恢复闸门通过
cases.given_en: A synthetic state halted at the SCN-05 stage
cases.when_en: Attempt to advance to the SCN-09 stage
cases.then_en: Advancement is refused until the resume gate passes

cases.title_zh: 中断语义的时间戳纪律
cases.title_en: Timestamp discipline for interruption semantics
cases.given_zh: 模板与合成运行记录
cases.when_zh: 核对 started/stopped/resumed/closed 时间戳
cases.then_zh: 模板中全部为 null；合成停机必须写 stopped_at 且禁止后续回执采集
cases.given_en: The template and synthetic run records
cases.when_en: Check started/stopped/resumed/closed timestamps
cases.then_en: All are null in the template; a synthetic halt must set stopped_at and forbid further receipt collection

cases.title_zh: 恢复必须四项条件齐备（逐项扫描）
cases.title_en: Resume requires all four conditions (sweep)
cases.given_zh: 合成停机状态与四项恢复条件
cases.when_zh: 逐项保留一项条件不为 verified
cases.then_zh: 每次恢复都被拒绝；四项齐备才允许进入 ready_for_resume
cases.given_en: A synthetic halted state and the four resume conditions
cases.when_en: Leave one condition unverified at a time
cases.then_en: Each resume is refused; only all four verified admit ready_for_resume

cases.title_zh: 恢复必须三方共同签署
cases.title_en: Resume requires three-role co-signature
cases.given_zh: 场地运营责任主体、安全复核、现场验证负责人三个签署位
cases.when_zh: 任一签署位不为 signed 时请求恢复
cases.then_zh: 恢复被拒绝；三方 signed 才可进入恢复流程
cases.given_en: The signoff slots for site operating principal, safety review, and field-validation lead
cases.when_en: Request resume with any slot not signed
cases.then_en: Resume is refused; all three signed are required to proceed

cases.title_zh: 恢复前必须按同一口径复测
cases.title_en: Re-measurement on the same basis before resume
cases.given_zh: 三条路线的 measurements 结构
cases.when_zh: 检查复测字段契约
cases.then_zh: 每条路线都保留时间、失败、价格、无障碍与人工接管的复测字段，且当前均为 not_observed
cases.given_en: The measurements structure of the three routes
cases.when_en: Check the re-measurement field contract
cases.then_en: Every route keeps time, failure, price, accessibility, and manual-takeover re-measurement fields, all currently not_observed

cases.title_zh: 无数据等价与人工复核覆盖全部 MVP 场景
cases.title_en: No-data equivalence and human review cover all MVP scenarios
cases.given_zh: evidence snapshot 与 public_space.geojson 中的 SCN-05/09/10
cases.when_zh: 核对 no_data_equivalent 与 human_review 字段及覆盖率指标
cases.then_zh: 三个场景均为 true；dazhongsi_mvp_no_data_route_coverage_ratio = 1.0
cases.given_en: SCN-05/09/10 in the evidence snapshot and public_space.geojson
cases.when_en: Check no_data_equivalent and human_review fields plus the coverage metric
cases.then_en: All three are true; dazhongsi_mvp_no_data_route_coverage_ratio = 1.0

cases.title_zh: 无数据等价正线在契约中可定位
cases.title_en: No-data equivalent main line locatable in the contract
cases.given_zh: field_routes 路线集合
cases.when_zh: 查找无数据等价正线
cases.then_zh: 存在该路线，route_status 为 not_observed，且保留完整测量字段
cases.given_en: The field_routes set
cases.when_en: Look for the no-data equivalent main line
cases.then_en: The route exists with route_status not_observed and a complete measurement schema

cases.title_zh: 无障碍核验点在路线内且人工接管有停机覆盖
cases.title_en: Accessibility point on a route and manual-takeover stop coverage
cases.given_zh: 无障碍连续路径核验点与六项停止触发器
cases.when_zh: 核对采集点归属与触发器语义
cases.then_zh: 无障碍核验点属于至少一条路线；人工接管不可用或未响应被停止触发器覆盖
cases.given_en: The continuous-accessibility verification point and six stop triggers
cases.when_en: Check point membership and trigger semantics
cases.then_en: The accessibility point belongs to at least one route; unavailable or unresponsive manual takeover is covered by a stop trigger

cases.title_zh: 元检查：实际执行的用例 ID 全集与钉死清单一致（含本项）
cases.title_en: Meta check: executed case-ID set equals the pinned list (including this one)
cases.given_zh: 本套件 expected_case_ids 清单
cases.when_zh: 运行后比对实际执行集合
cases.then_zh: 两者恰好相等；少跑一项与全部通过在输出上不可区分的情况被阻断
cases.given_en: This suite's expected_case_ids list
cases.when_en: Compare with the executed set after the run
cases.then_en: They match exactly; a silently skipped case becomes indistinguishable from a full pass and is blocked

negative_fixtures.target_en: Fill an observed location on a collection point

negative_fixtures.target_en: Point a collection point evidence_id at a missing receipt

negative_fixtures.target_en: Remove the staffed/offline withdrawal stop condition from SCN-09

negative_fixtures.target_en: Add a second A to an activity

negative_fixtures.target_en: Drop one case ID from the expected list
